name: STARCULT. Night: Twisted Age
source:
STARCULT. Night: Twisted Age is a dark fantasy visual novel with romance, set in a mysterious world on the brink of catastrophe.

Explore the life of Silviya, newly married into the Noble house of Nebula. Silviya is an Artist, but in this world such skills reach far beyond pastels and paints, and she married the young head of the house, Hans, hoping for a different life. The story begins with the brutal murder of her husband by an unknown monster just after their wedding. Silviya calls for a detective to investigate this mysterious crime. Just who is the real monster here?


You'll be able to:

Make meaningful choices, which will lead you to a variety of unique endings: Detective, Hedonist, Mystic, Nihilist, Ascended, and some secret endings for you to discover

Choose your relationships and their nature: spicy, romantic, toxic, sadistic, co-dependent, casual, open or platonic?

Read the true feelings and intentions of your friends and enemies by using Silviya's Emotion palette. Make them do what you want!

Create your own cult. Choose its purpose.
translation:
星教。《Night: Twisted Age》是一部浪漫的黑暗奇幻视觉小说，故事发生在一个濒临灾难边缘的神秘世界。

探索新嫁入星云贵族的西尔维娅的生活。西尔维娅是一位艺术家，但在这个世界上，这种技能远远超出了粉彩和绘画的范畴，她嫁给了年轻的主人汉斯，希望过上不同的生活。故事始于她的丈夫在他们的婚礼后不久被一个未知的怪物残忍杀害。西尔维娅呼吁侦探调查这起神秘的犯罪事件。这里真正的怪物是谁？


你将能够：

做出有意义的选择，这将引导你走向各种独特的结局：侦探、享乐主义、神秘、虚无主义、飞升，以及一些秘密结局等你发现

选择你的人际关系及其性质：辛辣的、浪漫的、有毒的、虐待狂的、相互依赖的、随意的、开放的还是柏拉图式的？

使用Silviya的情感调色板了解朋友和敌人的真实感受和意图。让他们做你想做的事！

创建你自己的邪教。选择其目的。
